description: This file defines the storage interface and in-memory implementation for the Raft consensus algorithm, including error definitions, storage methods, and snapshot management.

classes.name: MemoryStorage
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the Raft Storage interface, managing log entries, snapshots, and hard state.

methods.name: InitialState
methods.description: Returns the current HardState and ConfState.

methods.name: SetHardState
methods.description: Sets the HardState for the storage.

methods.name: Entries
methods.description: Retrieves log entries within a specified range, respecting size limits.

methods.name: Term
methods.description: Returns the term of a specific log entry.

methods.name: LastIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the last log entry.

methods.name: FirstIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the first log entry.

methods.name: ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Replaces current storage contents with a given snapshot.

methods.name: CreateSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current state at a specified index.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Discards log entries prior to a specified index.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends new log entries to storage.
